title: WhiteOut resource pack
description: Clean white minimalist PvP pack with improved visibility and smooth gameplay.
body:
A clean white minimalist PvP resource pack designed for smooth and focused gameplay. This pack improves visibility and removes unnecessary visual clutter, helping you concentrate on fights and react faster.

Includes custom:
• Diamond and Netherite armor
• Diamond and Netherite tools
• Swords
• Golden apples
• Ender pearls
• Other useful PvP items

The pack features a bright, simple, and polished style — perfect for PvP, duels, and competitive servers.![Image showing two wooden racks with various items: tools on one rack, golden apples, golden carrots, and other small items on the other rack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/572a7c20d46971bb01bc2a757d0759668e40cea1.png)
